correctness.rationale: The cover-image obstruction is exactly half the nearest nontrivial deck displacement plus distance to the straight-strip boundary. Möbius deck parity gives the competing radii \(a\) and \(\sqrt{a^2+4y^2}/2\), and the cylinder radius \(a/2\), all clipped by \(b-|y|\). Uniform \(|y|\) converts the event \(R\ge r\) to a single exact interval. The derived survival law, inverse cusp/atom classification and sharp three-phase maximizer are proved algebraically, with 72 independent deterministic numerical cross-checks from verify.py.
